# Hudu Provider

Manage Hudu IT documentation resources (companies, asset layouts, assets, networks, VLANs, VLAN zones) via Terraform/OpenTofu.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    hudu = {
      source  = "nnnc-org/hudu"
      version = "~> 0.1"
    }
  }
}

# host and api_key fall back to HUDU_API_HOST / HUDU_API_KEY.
provider "hudu" {
  host    = "https://hudu.example.com"
  api_key = var.hudu_api_key
}

variable "hudu_api_key" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) API key (sent as the `x-api-key` header). Falls back to the `HUDU_API_KEY` environment variable.
- `host` (String) Base URL of the Hudu instance, e.g. `https://hudu.example.com`. Falls back to the `HUDU_API_HOST` environment variable.
- `insecure` (Boolean) Skip TLS certificate verification. Defaults to `false`.
